blocks.text: Kimiyai manufacturing do bare sutoonon par khari hai: reaction engineering aur alehdgi ki technology (separation technology). Sanati paidawar mein kai kaleedi kimiyai amal use hote hain; kitab neeche diye amal batati hai.

Monomers naam ke chhote molecules jur kar polymers naam ki lambi chains banate hain. Addition polymerisation mein monomers koi atom khoye baghair aik doosre se jurte hain (maslan ethene monomers se poly(ethene)). Condensation polymerisation mein monomers jurte aur aik chhota molecule, aam taur par pani, chhorte hain (maslan monomers se polyesters). Kitab Engro Polymer and Chemicals ko Pakistan mein polyvinyl chloride (PVC) ka wahid producer batati hai.

Refining mein fractional distillation kache tel ko boiling points ke mutabiq products mein alag karti hai; sab se ahem fractions mein gasoline, diesel aur kerosene shamil hain. Reforming seedhi chain wale hydrocarbons ko shakh-dar mein badal kar fuel ka mayaar behtar karta hai; catalytic reforming mein hydrocarbons catalyst ke saath garam kar ke zyada octane wali gasoline banti hai. PARCO aur Attock Refinery jaisi refineries mein cracking aur reforming wasee kimiyai sanat ke liye zaruri petrochemical kacha maal dete hain.

Ammonia (NH3) nitrogen (N2) aur hydrogen (H2) se lohe ko catalyst bana kar banti hai: N2 + 3H2 <=> 2NH3. Kitab ke mutabiq yeh amal zameen par nitrogen fixation ka 13% hai, aur 70% ammonia seedha khaad banane mein use hoti hai. Engro Fertilizers aur FFC jaise bare plants qudrati gas ko kacha maal bana kar ammonia banate hain, jo phir urea mein badli jati hai.

Sulphur dioxide ko V2O5 ya platinum catalyst se sulphur trioxide mein badla jata hai: 2SO2 + O2 <=> 2SO3. SO3 jazb kar ke oleum banaya jata, jo phir sulphuric acid mein badalta hai: SO3 + H2SO4 -> H2S2O7, phir H2S2O7 + H2O -> 2H2SO4. Is amal se bohat khalis, garha H2SO4 milta hai. Sulphuric acid duniya mein sab se zyada use hone wala kimiyai maddah hai, is liye ise aksar 'kimiyai maddon ka badshah' kehte hain. Pakistan mein kai plants, maslan Nimir Industrial Chemicals, contact process chalate hain.

Solvay process namkeen pani (brine) aur chuna-pathar se sodium carbonate (Na2CO3) banata hai. Brine mein ammonia dali jati aur carbon dioxide guzari jati hai, jis se sodium hydrogencarbonate (NaHCO3) ka thos (precipitate) banta hai: NaCl + NH3 + CO2 + H2O -> NaHCO3 + NH4Cl. Garam karne se yeh sodium carbonate ban jata hai: 2NaHCO3 -> Na2CO3 + CO2 + H2O. Calcium carbonate ke tootne se mile chune (lime) se ammonia dobara hasil ki jati hai (CaCO3 -> CaO + CO2; CaO + 2NH4Cl -> CaCl2 + 2NH3 + H2O), aur zimni product calcium chloride (CaCl2) hai. Lucky Core Industries (pehle ICI) sheesha, detergent aur kaghaz ki sanaton ke liye soda ash banati hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar ki qataar: brine (NaCl) + NH3 -> carbonating tower -> solid NaHCO3 -> heat NaHCO3 -> Na2CO3 (soda ash). Garam kiya gaya chuna-pathar CO2 tower ko aur CaO recovery khane ko deta hai; NaHCO3 se bacha NH4Cl solution (dashed) recovery khane mein jata hai: CaO + NH4Cl -> NH3 + CaCl2. NH3 wapas brine mein, aur CaCl2 by-product.

blocks.text: Chlor-alkali process sodium chloride brine ki sanati electrolysis hai jo teen kaleedi products deti hai: chlorine (Cl2), sodium hydroxide (NaOH, caustic soda) aur hydrogen (H2): 2NaCl + 2H2O -> 2NaOH + Cl2 + H2. Yeh plastics, detergents aur pani saaf karne ki products banane ke liye zaruri hai, aur aam taur par zyada kaarkardagi aur khalisi ke liye jadeed membrane-cell technology use karta hai. Sitara Chemical Industries aur Ittehad Chemicals Pakistan mein bare producers hain, jo kapre aur pani ki safai ke shobon ko sahara dete hain.

blocks.alt: Membrane cell: baen taraf anode (+) brine (NaCl solution) mein, Cl2 oopar nikalti, 2Cl- -> Cl2 + 2e-. Beech mein ion-exchange membrane jis se Na+ daen jata hai. Daen taraf cathode (-) NaOH solution mein, H2 oopar nikalti, 2H2O + 2e- -> H2 + 2OH-. Neeche: 2NaCl + 2H2O -> 2NaOH + Cl2 + H2.
blocks.caption: Chlor-alkali membrane cell (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: (a) Haber-Bosch process aur (b) contact process mein use hone wala catalyst batayein.
Chlor-alkali process ki teen products kaun si hain?
blocks.explanation: Chlorine, sodium hydroxide (caustic soda) aur hydrogen.

items: Haber-Bosch: N2 + 3H2 <=> 2NH3 (loha); contact: SO2 se SO3 (V2O5) se H2SO4.
Solvay: brine aur chuna-pathar se Na2CO3; chlor-alkali: Cl2, NaOH, H2.
